evidence.reason: Real defect in existing intended behavior: the try/catch at lines 22–26 covers only readFile/JSON.parse, so a cache file containing `null` parses successfully into `record`, and line 27 accesses `record.history_digest` on null, throwing a TypeError outside the cache error handler. The comment at lines 9–13 states the cache is optional and a status poll must succeed without it (and line 39 repeats this), so an unreadable/odd cache must not break the poll. Fix is small and routine: after parsing, treat non-object parsed values (or null) as `{}`, e.g. `const parsed = JSON.parse(...); record = parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : {};`. No owner decision needed; no conflicting contract clause—this is ordinary correctness for the advisory cache.
